steps.summary: Climb ramps heading North → Kill Overseer Krow at the top platform → Climb into Overseer's Tower
steps.layout_tell: Whenever you hit a wall, take the wooden/stone ramp going UP and NORTH.
steps.next_exit: Kill Overseer Krow → Enter Overseer's Tower (Act 5 Town)
steps.portal_tip: After talking to NPCs in Town, exit down into The Control Blocks

actions.text: Run North up the slave pen ramps
Kill Overseer Krow at the top gate → Enter Overseer's Tower

steps.boss_info: Overseer Krow: Lightning/Physical mace slams & add waves.

variants.title: Vertical North Climb
variants.desc: Starts at bottom dock and exits at the top-center.

steps.summary: Hug the LEFT (West) wall to loot the Miasmeter → Then head North-East → Kill Justicar Casticus (+1 Pt)
steps.layout_tell: ⚡ CONTROL BLOCKS TELL: Miasmeter is ALWAYS along the West/Left perimeter; Casticus & the exit are ALWAYS at the North-East end!
steps.next_exit: Loot Miasmeter (Left) + Kill Casticus for Eyes of Zeal (+1 Pt) → Enter Oriath Square
steps.portal_tip: You can leap/dash through the broken cage bars on the right if you want a shortcut after Miasmeter!

actions.text: Hug LEFT wall to find Experimental Supplies → Loot Miasmeter
Head North-East → Kill Justicar Casticus & loot Eyes of Zeal
Enter Oriath Square

steps.boss_info: Justicar Casticus: Golden projectiles & ground degens.
steps.gem_reward: In Service to Science (Vilenta): Book of Skill (+1 Passive Skill Point)!

variants.title: West Quest / NE Exit
variants.desc: Left wall holds Miasmeter; top-right holds Casticus.

steps.summary: Tag Waypoint → Bridge is out, so loop North-West then North-East to The Templar Courts
steps.layout_tell: From the Waypoint near entrance, head North-East along the main streets to the Templar Courts gate.
steps.portal_tip: No side quests in Oriath Square — run straight through

actions.text: Tag Waypoint near entrance
Follow perimeter streets NE into The Templar Courts

variants.title: NE City Loop
variants.desc: Exit is always in the top-right corner of the square.

steps.summary: Loop Clockwise (Up → Right → Down) around the outer halls → Enter The Chamber of Innocence
steps.layout_tell: The Templar Courts is always a U-turn / Clockwise loop starting SW and exiting SE.
steps.portal_tip: Stay along the outer hallways to avoid dead-end courtyards

actions.text: Run North-West, then East, then South-East around the loop
Enter The Chamber of Innocence

steps.boss_info: Templar Flamecallers: Watch out for synchronized Flameblasts.

variants.title: Clockwise U-Loop
variants.desc: Always loops around the central courtyard.

steps.summary: Tag Waypoint → Spiral Counter-Clockwise (Left → Down → Right → Up) → Kill High Templar Avarius / Innocence
steps.layout_tell: ⚡ SPIRAL TELL: From the Waypoint, ALWAYS go Left (NW) first, then loop Counter-Clockwise to the Sanctum!
steps.next_exit: Kill Avarius / Innocence → Exit via The Torched Courts
steps.portal_tip: Hide behind a frozen statue whenever Innocence casts his giant golden bullet-hell orb!

actions.text: Tag Waypoint & head LEFT (West) to start the counter-clockwise spiral
Kill High Templar Avarius & Innocence (hide behind statues for orb!)
Talk to Sin & Bannon → Exit right into The Torched Courts

steps.boss_info: Innocence, God-Emperor: Massive Fire & Physical damage. Bullet-hell orb deals lethal Fire damage unless blocked by a statue.
steps.gem_reward: Opens the second half of Act 5.

variants.title: Fixed CCW Spiral
variants.desc: Always goes West → South → East → North → Center.

steps.summary: Run the exact reverse loop of Templar Courts (Up → Left → Down) → Enter The Ruined Square
steps.layout_tell: Torched Courts is the mirror of Templar Courts: loop Counter-Clockwise to the South-West exit.

actions.text: Loop North, then West, then South-West
Enter The Ruined Square

steps.boss_info: Kitava Heralds: Leap slam + Mortar projectiles.

variants.title: CCW U-Loop
variants.desc: Starts SE and exits SW into Ruined Square.

steps.summary: Hug top wall to North-West corner → TAG WAYPOINT → Enter The Ossuary right beside the WP!
steps.layout_tell: ⚡ RUINED SQUARE CORNERS: NW = Waypoint + The Ossuary; South = The Reliquary (+1 Pt); NE = Cathedral Rooftop (Kitava)!
steps.next_exit: Tag NW Waypoint → Enter The Ossuary
steps.portal_tip: Always tag the NW Waypoint right outside The Ossuary so you can teleport back after Reliquary!

actions.text: Head North-West to the top-left corner & TAG WAYPOINT
Enter The Ossuary right next to the Waypoint

steps.boss_info: Utula (Optional unique boss in square): Skip during speed leveling.

variants.title: Fixed Corner POIs
variants.desc: NW = Ossuary + WP, S = Reliquary, NE = Cathedral Rooftop.

steps.summary: Loop Clockwise to back tomb → Loot Sign of Purity → Then do The Reliquary (3 Torments = +1 Skill Pt!)
steps.layout_tell: In The Ossuary, the Sign of Purity is always at the opposite end of the figure-8 loop from the entrance.
steps.next_exit: Loot Sign of Purity → Exit to Ruined Square → Do Reliquary (South) → Go NE to Cathedral Rooftop
steps.portal_tip: In The Reliquary, check the 3 outer corners for Kitava's Torments (+1 Passive Skill Point)!

actions.text: In The Ossuary: Loop to back room → Click Tomb for Sign of Purity
In Ruined Square: Go South to The Reliquary → Loot 3 Torments (+1 Pt)
Take WP to Ruined Square → Go NE into The Cathedral Rooftop

steps.boss_info: Bone Husks: Cast bone nova spikes on death.
steps.gem_reward: Kitava's Torments (Lani in Town): Book of Skill (+1 Passive Skill Point)!

variants.title: Circular Tomb
variants.desc: Exit shortcut opens right behind the Sign of Purity.

steps.summary: Run straight North-West along the rooftop → Place Sign of Purity → Kill Kitava → Sail with Lilly to Act 6
steps.layout_tell: 100% linear rooftop leading North-West into the Cathedral Apex.
steps.next_exit: Kill Kitava → Talk to Lilly Roth on boat → Enter Act 6
steps.portal_tip: ⚡ WARNING: Defeating Act 5 Kitava applies a permanent -30% to All Resistances!

actions.text: Run NW along the rooftop into the Cathedral Apex
Kill Kitava (dodge sweeping fire/X-blast & kill Heart adds)
Sail with Lilly Roth to Lioneye's Watch (Act 6)

steps.boss_info: Kitava, the Insatiable: Heavy Physical & Fire sweeping slams, X-blasts, and dark ground degen.
